//: Design-system guardrails for US 1.3 / T-1.3.15. Bans raw hex codes and raw px values so components must use design tokens. See ../docs/design-system.md (landing via US 1.3 / T-1.3.14).

color-no-hex.message: Use a design token (e.g. var(--color-primary)) instead of a raw hex code. See docs/design-system.md.

declaration-property-unit-disallowed-lis.message: Use a design-system token (var(--space-*), var(--font-size-*), var(--radius-*)) instead of a raw px value. See docs/design-system.md.

overrides.//: Token definition files are the one place raw hex + px values are allowed.
